rationale: Firmware creates no std channels: one-shot replies use bitaxe_runtime::reply and queues use bitaxe_runtime::queue, because the Xtensa LLVM backend realigns their frames without movsp (https://github.com/espressif/llvm-project/issues/140, https://github.com/esp-rs/rust/issues/284). Add an entry only with a reviewed reason why the caller cannot be interrupted in the realigning prologue.
